table.description: One Highway Statistics table as FHWA publishes it (Excel): travel (VM-2 vehicle-miles by state and functional system), drivers (DL-22 by age and sex), vehicles (MV-1 registrations), roads (HM-20 public road length), motor fuel (MF-1 state fuel taxes) and Highway Trust Fund (FE-9) ... Default: every line numbered (row, col1...) to find the header lines; then header_lines names the columns.

year.desc: the Highway Statistics edition year, e.g. 2023 (the data year for most tables)

table.desc: table id in lower case without the hyphen: vm2, dl22, mv1, hm20, mf1, fe9 ...

sheet.desc: sheet name or number (default 1, not counting the hidden CRYSTAL_PERSIST sheet); DL-22 has MALES, FEMALES, TOTAL

header_lines.desc: the header line numbers, e.g. '5-8' for VM-2

header_row.desc: one header line instead; 0 (default) returns every line numbered

carry.desc: which header lines span to the right over blank cells: top (default), all, none; check the names against the numbered lines
